Rashi on Nazir 25a:1:1.hebrew: א"ר יוחנן הלכה היא בנזיר - כך: דהואיל וסתומין הן, אע"פ שמעורבין הן, יפלו לנדבה:
Rashi on Nazir 25a:1:1.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan said: It is a halakha with regard to a nazirite - [The halakha is] this: Since they are unallocated, even though [funds for a sin-offering] are mingled [in them], they shall be allocated for gift offerings.

Rashi on Nazir 25a:1:2.hebrew: מותר נדר יהא לנדבה - והכא נמי, כיון דהני מעות לא צריכי, שכבר מת — הוו להו מותר ויפלו לנדבה, ואין חוששין לדמי חטאת שבהן:
Rashi on Nazir 25a:1:2.english: The surplus of a vow shall be for a gift offering - And here too, since these funds are not needed, as he has already died — they are considered surplus and shall go to [freewill] gift offerings, and we are not concerned about the sin-offering money that is among them.

Rashi on Nazir 25a:2:1.hebrew: אמטו להכי סתומין - תנן דיפלו לנדבה, דאין הלכה בידינו אלא מסתומין:
Rashi on Nazir 25a:2:1.english: It is for this reason that unallocated [funds] - we learned [in the Mishnah] that they shall fall to voluntary [offerings], for we have a received Halakha only regarding unallocated [funds].

Rashi on Nazir 25a:2:2.hebrew: אלא לר"ל - דמפיק ליה מן קרא, מאי איריא סתומין? אפילו מפורשין! כיון דמת, הוה ליה מותר, ואמאי תני דמי חטאת ילכו לים המלח:
Rashi on Nazir 25a:2:2.english: However, according to Reish Lakish - Who derives it from a verse: Why specifically unallocated [funds]? Even allocated [funds]! Since [the nazirite] died, it has become surplus, and why does [the Mishnah] teach [that] the money for the sin-offering shall go to the Dead Sea?

Rashi on Nazir 25a:3:1.hebrew: כבר פסקה תנא דבי ר"י - דלמיתה אזלא:
Rashi on Nazir 25a:3:1.english: The tanna of the school of Rabbi Yishmael already ruled it - That it goes to [its] death:

Rashi on Nazir 25a:3:2.hebrew: רק קדשיך אשר יהיו לך וגו' - מי הן אותן קדשים שהן עכשיו ועתידים להעמיד אחרים תחתיהם, שריבה הכתוב "אשר יהיו לך"? הוי אומר: ולדי קדשים ותמורתן. ומה הן תקנתן? כמו שנאמר לאחריו:
Rashi on Nazir 25a:3:2.english: “Only your sacred things that you have, etc.” - Which are those consecrated [animals] that exist now and are destined to establish others in their stead, which Scripture included [by stating] “that shall be to you”? You must say: The offspring of consecrated [animals] and their substitutes. And what is their remedy? As is stated after it:

Rashi on Nazir 25a:4:1.hebrew: תשא ובאת אל המקום - שלא שינה בהן הכתוב משאר קדשים שעולים אל המקום, כדכתיב בפרשת ויקרא: ״אם עולה קרבנו מן הבקר זכר תמים יקריבנו אל פתח אהל מועד״, וכך כתוב בזבחי שלמים:
Rashi on Nazir 25a:4:1.english: “You shall take and go to the place” - That Scripture did not distinguish them from other consecrated offerings, which are brought up to the Place, as it is written in the portion of Vayikra: “If his offering is a burnt-offering from the herd, an unblemished male he shall bring it, to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting” (Leviticus 1:3); and so it is written regarding peace-offerings.

Rashi on Nazir 25a:4:2.hebrew: יכול יעלם לבית הבחירה וימנע מהם מים ומזון - שיכניסם לכיפה בשביל שימותו. ת"ל לאחריו: "ועשית עולותיך הבשר והדם על מזבח וגו' ודם זבחיך ישפך על מזבח ה' אלהיך והבשר תאכל", לומר לך: כשם שאתה נוהג בעולה נהוג בתמורתה, כדרך שנוהג בשלמים נהוג בולדותיהם. ולדותיהן לגבי עולה לא חשיב — דאין עולה באה אלא זכר, אבל שלמים "אם זכר אם נקבה" כתיב; וכן נמי באשם ליכא ולד, דאינו בא אלא זכר:
Rashi on Nazir 25a:4:2.english: One might [think] he must bring them up to the Temple and withhold water and food from them - That he should place them into a cell so that they will die. The verse states after it: “And you shall sacrifice your burnt-offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar... and the blood of your offerings shall be poured out against the altar of the Lord your God, and you shall eat the flesh” (Deuteronomy 12:27), to tell you: Just as you treat a burnt-offering, treat its substitute; in the manner that you treat peace-offerings, treat their offspring. Offspring with regard to a burnt-offering [the baraita] did not reckon, as a burnt-offering comes only [from a] male; but regarding peace-offerings, “whether male or female” (Leviticus 3:1) is written. And similarly with a guilt-offering as well, there is no offspring, since it comes only [from a] male.

Rashi on Nazir 25a:5:1.hebrew: ת"ל רק - שאין הכתוב מדבר אלא בתמורת עולה ולדות שלמים, ולא בולד חטאת ותמורת אשם. ו"דם זבחיך ישפך" דכתיב בקרא — היינו שלמים:
Rashi on Nazir 25a:5:1.english: The verse states: “Only” - For Scripture speaks only of the substitute of a burnt-offering and the offspring of peace-offerings, and not of the offspring of a sin-offering or the substitute of a guilt-offering. And “the blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out” that is written in the verse — that is peace-offerings.

Rashi on Nazir 25a:6:1.hebrew: ר"ע אומר אינו צריך - למעט אשם, שהרי הוא אומר: ״אשם הוא״ — בהוייתו. ולקמן מפרש מאי קאמר:
Rashi on Nazir 25a:6:1.english: Rabbi Akiva says: [It is] not necessary - [A verse is not necessary] to exclude a guilt-offering, for behold, it says: “It is a guilt-offering” — in its [current] state. And later, [the Gemara] explains what he means.

Rashi on Nazir 25a:7:1.hebrew: קתני יכול יעלם - כמו ״אמר מר: יכול יעלם, ת"ל: ועשית עולותיך הבשר והדם״. טעמא דכתב רחמנא ״ועשית עולותיך״ — משום הכי לא יומתו ולדי שלמים ותמורת עולה, הא אי לא כתב קרא — אזלי למיתה:
Rashi on Nazir 25a:7:1.english: It teaches: One might [think] he should bring them up - [This is] like [saying,] “The Master said: ‘One might [think] he should bring them up; the verse states: “And you shall sacrifice your burnt-offerings, the flesh and the blood”’”; [meaning,] the reason the Merciful One wrote “and you shall sacrifice your burnt-offerings” is that on that account the offspring of peace-offerings and the substitute of a burnt-offering are not put to death, which implies that if the verse had not written [this], they would go to death.

Rashi on Nazir 25a:7:2.hebrew: אמאי הא גבי ולדות חטאת הוא דגמרי מיתה - בלבד, במס' תמורה (דף כא:), ולא גבי שאר ולדות קדשים ותמורותיהם:
Rashi on Nazir 25a:7:2.english: Why? After all, it is regarding the offspring of a sin-offering that they learned [they are left to] die - Exclusively, in Tractate Temurah (daf 21b), and not regarding other offspring of consecrated [animals] and their substitutions.

Rashi on Nazir 25a:7:3.hebrew: אי לאו קרא - ״ועשית עולותיך״, הוה אמינא: ולדי חטאת מתים בכל מקום שהן:
Rashi on Nazir 25a:7:3.english: If not for the verse - [Namely,] “And you shall make your burnt-offerings,” I would say: The offspring of a sin-offering die wherever they are.

Tosafot on Nazir 25a:1:1.hebrew: הלכה היא בנזיר - הלכה למשה מסיני הוא, [דסתומין] יפלו לנדבה, אע"פ שדמי חטאת מעורבין בהן. ואדרבה, לקמן מוכחא: כשדמי חטאת דוקא מעורב בהן, [אז] (נדר) נתקבלה הלכה שיפלו לנדבה; אבל אם דמי עולה ושלמים לבד מעורבין יחד, לא נאמר בהן שיפלו לנדבה, אלא יביא חציין עולה וחציין שלמים:
Tosafot on Nazir 25a:1:1.english: It is a halakha with regard to a nazirite - It is a halakha transmitted to Moses from Sinai that unallocated [funds] shall fall to gift offerings, even though money for a sin-offering is mingled with them. And on the contrary, it is proven below that specifically when money for a sin-offering is mingled with them, [then] was the halakha received that they should fall to gift offerings; but if only money for a burnt-offering and a peace-offering is mingled together, it was not stated regarding them that they should fall to gift offerings, but rather he brings half of them [as] a burnt-offering and half of them [as] a peace-offering.

Tosafot on Nazir 25a:1:2.hebrew: רבי שמעון בן לקיש אומר לכל נדריהם ולכל נדבותם התורה אמרה מותר נדר יהיה לנדבה - וכל קרבנות נזיר בנדר הם באין, ע"י שנדר בנדור, ואפילו החטאת. וסברא הוא לאוקומי במותר כי האי, דבשאר מותר לא משכחת לה — דאם הפריש [מעות] לעולה ונתותרו, שהוזלו הבהמות, יכול להקריב מהם עולה, וכן שלמים, כמו שהפריש מתחילה; וסברא להעמידם במותר סתום כי האי: חטאת, עולה ושלמים מעורבין יחד:
Tosafot on Nazir 25a:1:2.english: Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish says: "Whether for any of their vows or for any of their gift offerings," the Torah states [that] the surplus of a vow shall be for a gift offering - And all offerings of a nazirite come through a vow, by means of [the fact] that he took a vow, and even the sin-offering. And it is logical to interpret [the verse as referring to] a surplus like this, for in other [cases of] surplus you do not find it — for if one set aside [money] for a burnt-offering and there was a surplus because the animals depreciated, he can sacrifice a burnt-offering from them, and likewise [with] peace-offerings, just as he initially designated; and it is logical to interpret it [as referring to] an unallocated surplus like this: [where funds for] a sin-offering, a burnt-offering, and peace-offerings are mixed together.

Tosafot on Nazir 25a:2:1.hebrew: בשלמא לר' יוחנן דאמר הלכה היא בנזיר אמטו להכי סתומין אין מפורשין לא - שכן נשנית הלכה למשה מסיני. אלא לרבי שמעון בן לקיש — אפילו מפורשין, דנימא: מקרא מלא דבר הכתוב; ואמאי תני במתניתין: מפורשין — לא:
Tosafot on Nazir 25a:2:1.english: Granted, according to Rabbi Yoḥanan, who said [that] it is a halakha with regard to a nazirite, for this reason unallocated, yes; allocated, no - For so was the halakha transmitted to Moses from Sinai taught. But according to Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish, [it should apply] even [to] allocated [funds], for let us say that Scripture stated a full verse; and [if so,] why did [the Tanna] teach in the Mishnah: allocated, no?

Tosafot on Nazir 25a:3:1.hebrew: מפורשין לא מצית אמרת - דיפלו לנדבה; דכבר פסקה תנא דבי רבי ישמעאל דולד חטאת מתה ולא לנדבה, וה"נ נימא במותר שלה דלאיבוד אזיל ולא לנדבה, דהכל נקרא "מותר חטאת": בין ולד חטאת, בין תמורת חטאת, כי הכא דמפריש מפורשין והיפר לה בעלה, או ההיא דתנן במסכת מעילה (דף יא.): היכא דהפריש מעות לנזירותו ומת והיו לו מעות מפורשין — כל אלה שאינן חטאת עצמן, שם מותרות עליהם. וה"ה דמצי למימר דהלכה גמירי לה: חטאת מתה; אלא ניחא ליה לאתויי תנא דבי רבי ישמעאל, [דתנא] חטאת מתה, עולה ושלמים יקריבו שלמים, כל אחד כדיניה, כמו במשנתינו דקאמר: עולה תיקרב עולה:
Tosafot on Nazir 25a:3:1.english: You cannot say [that] allocated [funds] - [should] fall to freewill offerings; for the tanna of the school of Rabbi Yishmael has already ruled that the offspring of a sin-offering dies, and [goes] not to freewill offerings. And so too let us say regarding its surplus that it goes to destruction and not to freewill offerings, for everything is called the "surplus of a sin-offering": whether the offspring of a sin-offering, whether the substitute of a sin-offering, as here where [a woman] designates allocated [funds] and her husband annulled [her vow], or that which we learned in tractate Me'ilah (11a): where one designated money for his naziriteship and died, and he had allocated money — all of these that are not the sin-offering itself, the designation of surplus applies to them. And by the same token, [Rava] could have said that we learned by tradition [halakhah] that a sin-offering dies; rather, it was preferable to him to cite the tanna of the school of Rabbi Yishmael, [who taught that] a sin-offering dies, [and] a burnt-offering and peace-offerings they shall offer [as burnt-offerings and] peace-offerings, each according to its law, just as in our Mishnah where it states: "A burnt-offering shall be offered as a burnt-offering."

Tosafot on Nazir 25a:3:2.hebrew: רק קדשיך אשר יהיו לך - בתמורה בריש פ' אלו קדשים דריש: "רק קדשיך" — אלו התמורות, "אשר יהיו לך" — אלו הוולדות. דלעולה ושלמים גופייהו לא איצטריך, שהרי כבר מפורש בויקרא: "זאת תורת עולה ותורת שלמים":
Tosafot on Nazir 25a:3:2.english: “Only your sacred things that you have” - In [tractate] Temurah, at the beginning of the chapter [entitled] Elu Kodashim (17b), it expounds: “Only your sacred things” — these are the substitutes; “that you have” — these are the offspring. For concerning the burnt-offering and peace-offering themselves, [a verse] was not needed, as it is already explicit in Leviticus: “This is the law of the burnt-offering and the law of the peace-offering.”

Tosafot on Nazir 25a:4:1.hebrew: ומאי תקנתן תשא ובאת בירושלים יכול יעלם לבית הבחירה וימנע מהם מים ומזון כדי שימותו - כלומר: יכניסם כדרך שעושין בולד חטאת ובתמורת חטאת, דאזלו למיתה:
Tosafot on Nazir 25a:4:1.english: “And what is their remedy? ‘You shall take and go’ to Jerusalem. One might [have thought] he should bring them up to the Chosen House and withhold water and food from them so that they die” - That is to say, [one might think that] he should put them [into a chamber] in the manner that they do with the offspring of a sin-offering and with the substitute of a sin-offering, which are left to die.

Tosafot on Nazir 25a:4:2.hebrew: ת"ל ועשית עולותיך הבשר והדם - סיפא דהאי קרא: "ודם זבחיך ישפך והבשר תאכל", והיינו שלמים. וסמיך ליה האי קרא: "רק קדשיך", לומר לך: כדרך שאתה נוהג בעולה — כלומר, שקריבין למזבח — נהוג בתמורתן; וכדרך שאתה נוהג בשלמים — דסיפיה דקרא איירי בשלמים, דכתיב: "והבשר תאכל" — נהוג בולדה. ונקט תמורה לגבי עולה — דזכר, לא שייך ביה ולד; וגבי שלמים, דנקבה, נקט ולד:
Tosafot on Nazir 25a:4:2.english: “The verse states: ‘And you shall sacrifice your burnt-offerings, the flesh and the blood’” - The end of this verse is: “And the blood of your offerings shall be poured out... and you shall eat the flesh” (Deuteronomy 12:27), and this refers to peace-offerings. And this verse is juxtaposed to “Only your sacred things” (Deuteronomy 12:26), to tell you: In the manner that you treat a burnt-offering — that is, that they are offered on the altar — you must treat their substitute; and in the manner that you treat peace-offerings — for the end of the verse deals with peace-offerings, as it is written: “and you shall eat the flesh” — you must treat its offspring. And [the baraita] mentioned a substitute regarding a burnt-offering, because [being] a male, offspring does not apply to it; and regarding peace-offerings, which [can be] female, it mentioned offspring.

Tosafot on Nazir 25a:5:1.hebrew: יכול אף ולד חטאת ותמורת אשם וכו' - גבי חטאת נקט ולד, שהיא באה נקבה, וגבי אשם תמורה, שהוא בא זכר. והכי קאמר: יכול אף בולד חטאת תנהוג בו דין חטאת, ובתמורת אשם דין אשם — כלומר, שיקרב לשם חטאת ולשם אשם — תלמוד לומר: "רק", למעוטי ולד חטאת ותמורת אשם; דאכין ורקין מיעוטין:
Tosafot on Nazir 25a:5:1.english: "One might have thought that the offspring of a sin-offering and the substitute of a guilt-offering, etc." - Regarding a sin-offering, [the Baraita] mentioned "offspring" because it is brought as a female, and regarding a guilt-offering, "substitute" because it is brought as a male. And this is what it is saying: One might have thought that also regarding the offspring of a sin-offering you should apply to it the law of a sin-offering, and regarding the substitute of a guilt-offering the law of a guilt-offering — that is to say, that it should be sacrificed as a sin-offering and as a guilt-offering — [therefore] the verse states: "Only," to exclude the offspring of a sin-offering and the substitute of a guilt-offering; for akhin and rakin are limiting terms.

Tosafot on Nazir 25a:6:1.hebrew: ר"ע אומר [אינו צריך] - דאינו מביא לאשם אלא אשם עצמו:
Tosafot on Nazir 25a:6:1.english: Rabbi Akiva says: [“It is not necessary”] - For one brings as a guilt-offering only the guilt-offering itself.

Tosafot on Nazir 25a:7:1.english: "[The baraita] teaches: One might have thought that one must bring them up" - [This] is like [saying], "The Master said [above]".

Tosafot on Nazir 25a:7:2.hebrew: ואמאי הא גבי ולד חטאת הוא דגמירי מיתה - דהילכתא גמירי לה, דחמש חטאות מתות, ואלו הן: [ולד] חטאת, ותמורת חטאת, וחטאת שמתו בעליה, ושנתכפרו בעליה באחר, ושעברה שנתה. והואיל ולא איירי בשלמים ועולה — מהיכא תיתי שימותו:
Tosafot on Nazir 25a:7:2.english: "And why? After all, it is regarding the offspring of a sin-offering that we learned [that it is left to] die" - For it is learned as a Halakhah [transmitted to Moses from Sinai] that five [types of] sin-offerings are left to die, and these are they: [the offspring of] a sin-offering, the substitute of a sin-offering, a sin-offering whose owner died, [one] whose owner achieved atonement through another [animal], and [one] whose year has passed. And since [the Halakhah] does not deal with peace-offerings and burnt-offerings, from where would it enter one's mind that they should die?

Tosafot on Nazir 25a:7:3.hebrew: אי לאו קרא הוה אמינא ולד חטאת בכ"מ - שירצה בגבולין שימותו, אבל מעולה ומשלמים יביאם לבית הבחירה:
Tosafot on Nazir 25a:7:3.english: "If not for the verse, I would say [that] the offspring of a sin-offering [may die] anywhere" - That [wherever] one wishes in the provinces, they may die; but [the offspring and substitutes] of a burnt-offering and peace-offerings, one must bring them to the Temple [as sacrifices].
